comparison.objective: Shim a door jamb with opposed wedges without bowing it; candidate installs and secures a telescoping rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Opposed wedge driving and force-limited gap filling versus long-part support, spring-tab actuation, paired-prong insertion, telescoping alignment, and screw fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Shim overlap, snugness, and jamb bow limits versus four prongs retained at one rack unit, springs extended, correct bottom-hole screws, self-support, and 3 s release.
comparison.reason: The objectives and tested mechanics differ substantially; bimanual support and insertion are only generic shared primitives. Candidate force and damage thresholds remain uncalibrated, but that does not suggest duplication.
